stage_name: D3.5-A6 Phase 0-R1 — Replay-Surface & Budget-Decision Contract Repair
stage_type: narrow preregistration-contract repair only; no Phase-1 implementation, no real admission treatment, no reranker/scorer/model calls, no runtime/D1/database changes

repair_issues.description: post-rerank deterministic replay metadata is incompletely specified: the Phase-0 contract partly conflates the reranker input payload with the post-rerank deterministic selector replay state

K2/K3 benefit + safety decision semantics are not fully conflict-free: benefit wording alternates between 'all evaluator-applicable required evidence groups' and 'applicable bridge evidence'; no incremental benefit metric, no safety-before-minimality ordering, no causal witness, overlapping PARTIAL labels

BASELINE graph-channel authority wording is ambiguous: the Phase-0 chain reads 'frozen v2 selectivity -> frozen graph merge -> frozen fusion' although selectivity_only_graph_ordering is already the final persisted v2-conditioned graph-channel ordering

RERANKER_PAYLOAD_SURFACE.definition: the exact payload submitted to the existing reranker
RERANKER_PAYLOAD_SURFACE.purpose: exists only to call the unchanged reranker
RERANKER_PAYLOAD_SURFACE.prohibition: no selector-only metadata is added to the model prompt

POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_REPLAY_SURFACE.definition: a separate deterministic replay surface, independent of the reranker payload, sufficient to reproduce the existing production post-rerank logic exactly
required_per_object_fields: full locator (complete raw locator dict; the duplicate-locator identity is the canonical JSON dump of the entire locator)
channel membership (reproducible from the frozen channel orderings)
fusion score (reproducible from the frozen fusion contract)
POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_REPLAY_SURFACE.registry_separation: model-visible reranker fields and selector-only replay fields must be explicitly separated (e.g., reranker_payload_registry vs selector_replay_registry or clearly namespaced fields); the exact Phase-1 schema is free, the semantic separation is frozen now

POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVE.definition: union of (1) every object in the full v2-conditioned fused ordering; (2) every object in the frozen exact channel needed for symbol_first; (3) every reserved bridge candidate; (4) every additional object referenced by deterministic final-selector logic before final_evidence_limit can be satisfied
POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVE.mechanically_computed_superset: under the frozen fusion construction every channel member receives a fused score and ordered = dedupe([*reranked, *full_fused_order]) only ever contains fused-ordering members, so the complete required universe equals the member set of the full v2-conditioned fused ordering; Phase 1 computes it deterministically per case — a complete superset, never outcome-shaped incremental filling

selector_text_contract.chosen: OPTION A — persist the complete selector-visible frozen text needed by production logic
repository_evidence: symbol_first checks plan symbols against the exact-channel item's full text (src/panda_agent/retrieval.py: literal in item['text'])
_evidence constructs Evidence.text from the full payload text (src/panda_agent/retrieval.py)
GoldEvidenceSelector.matches title_contains searches the evidence item's full text joined with title and section_path (src/panda_agent/evaluation.py)
selector_text_contract.OPTION_B_rejected_because: text[:2000] == production selector text cannot be proven: whether a plan symbol or title_contains needle occurs beyond character 2000 is data-dependent, so no generic mechanical equivalence proof exists; assuming equality without proof is prohibited
selector_text_contract.reranker_payload_unchanged: the reranker model still receives text[:2000] only

complete_replay_surface_gate.rule: before any Phase-2 reranker outcome, Phase 1 mechanically materializes the full required replay surface (100% of the required universe with all required selector fields) from the frozen normalized corpus and frozen trace state; runtime KeyError-driven incremental repair is PROHIBITED
gate_conditions: post-rerank deterministic selector replay synthetic/parity tests pass

post_rerank_replay_surface_contract.POST_RERANK_SELECTOR_PARITY_TARGET: production retrieval.py deterministic post-rerank behavior, including ordered fallback construction, preferred_sources, symbol_first, required_first, hinted_first, final ordered deduplication, select_final_evidence, and final_evidence_limit = 12; no simplified evaluation-only substitute unless proven semantically identical

complete_object_universe_contract.POST_RERANK_REPLAY_REQUIRED_OBJECT_UNIVE: union of (1) every object in the full v2-conditioned fused ordering; (2) every object in the frozen exact channel needed for symbol_first; (3) every reserved bridge candidate; (4) every additional object referenced by deterministic final-selector logic before final_evidence_limit can be satisfied
complete_object_universe_contract.mechanically_computed_superset: equals the member set of the full v2-conditioned fused ordering under the frozen fusion construction; computed deterministically per case in Phase 1 — a complete superset, never outcome-shaped incremental filling

selector_text_contract.reranker_payload_unchanged: the reranker model still receives text[:2000] only

baseline_graph_authority.rationale: the persisted field is already the final v2-conditioned graph-channel ordering (selected bridge prefix + ordinary unbridged graph under GRAPH_CHANNEL_LIMIT = 20) produced by the frozen v2 implementation
corrected_baseline_chain: persisted A5-R2 final v2-conditioned graph channel (consumed as-is)
frozen fusion with unchanged non-graph channels
full fused ordering (deterministic recomputation; tie-breaking per the existing frozen fusion implementation)
baseline_graph_authority.full_fused_ordering_authority: deterministically recomputed from the persisted final graph channel + frozen non-graph channels + frozen RRF weights; deterministic replay, not new retrieval

phase1_reexecution_prohibitions.double_graph_merge: PROHIBITED (selectivity_only_graph_ordering must never be merged with the selected bridge prefix again)
phase1_reexecution_prohibitions.equivalence_check_only: Phase 1 may verify persisted selectivity_only_graph_ordering == merge_ids(selected_object_ids, unbridged_graph_ordering, GRAPH_CHANNEL_LIMIT) for all six cases; the persisted ordering remains the runtime replay input; parity failure -> STOP BEFORE IMPLEMENTATION FREEZE (no opportunistic representation choice)

admission_benefit_population.ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP: a required evidence group is an ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP iff the deterministic evaluator identifies at least one required candidate for that group AND at least one such required candidate belongs to RESERVABLE_BRIDGE for that case
admission_benefit_population.classification_timing: evaluator-only; occurs after pool construction and output freeze; must never affect runtime admission
admission_benefit_population.already_baseline_bridge_evidence: a required bridge candidate already present in BASELINE_TOP30 consumes zero reservation slots, so its group is useful for control/retention diagnostics but does not count as evidence that reserved admission created incremental reachability

incremental_benefit_metrics.DELTA_K: number of ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUPs that are STABLE_RETAINED under treatment K AND NOT STABLE_RETAINED under BASELINE
incremental_benefit_metrics.primary_rule: budget selection is based on incremental admission benefit + safety; total stable retained groups are never the primary K benefit metric

safety_metrics.safety_population: all evaluator-required/control groups that are BASELINE_STABLE (not only admission-target groups)
safety_metrics.REGRESSION_K: number of MATERIAL_CONTROL_REGRESSION groups under budget K

safe_effective_definition.ordering: the safety filter occurs BEFORE smallest-budget preference

hierarchy: if K2 is SAFE_EFFECTIVE and K3 is SAFE_EFFECTIVE: SELECTED_ADMISSION_BUDGET = 3 if DELTA_3 > DELTA_2 else 2
else: no budget is selected as PASS
budget_decision_rule.meaning: smallest sufficient SAFE budget, not merely smallest budget
budget_decision_rule.rank_only_rule: if DELTA_2 == DELTA_3 and both are safe-effective: choose K2 even if K3 improves median rank or MRR-like diagnostics
budget_decision_rule.unsafe_smaller_budget_prohibition: DELTA_2 == DELTA_3 -> choose K2 is PROHIBITED when REGRESSION_2 > 0 AND REGRESSION_3 == 0; safety is evaluated before budget minimality
budget_decision_rule.budget_identity_prohibition: the budget is never chosen from positive-case identity

causal_witness_contract.RESERVED_REQUIRED_CANDIDATE_RETAINED: evaluator-only diagnostic: for each ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP/repetition, record whether the final evidence actually contains a required-evidence matching candidate that consumed a reserved slot in that treatment arm
causal_witness_contract.PASS_requirement: PASS requires at least one ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP with DELTA_K benefit AND STABLE_RESERVED_REQUIRED_WITNESS under the selected budget; without that witness, direct bridge-admission recovery is not claimed
causal_witness_contract.POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY: final evidence improves relative to baseline but the improvement is not carried by an actually reserved required candidate; recorded as a diagnostic only and never sufficient for the mechanistic PASS requirement
causal_witness_contract.UNSTABLE_ADMISSION_RECOVERY: an ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP is retained in at least one treatment repetition where the corresponding BASELINE repetition/stable baseline state does not establish stable retention, but the group does not satisfy DELTA_K stable recovery; isolated reranker variance is never confused with stable treatment effect

total_deterministic_order_no_outcome_dep: 3. PASS if a SAFE_EFFECTIVE budget exists and the required stable reserved-candidate witness exists
4. PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_WITH_CONTROL_REGRESSION if DELTA_K > 0 exists but no effective budget is safe

5. PARTIAL / ADMISSION_RECOVERY_NOT_STABLE_ACROSS_RERANKER_REPETITIONS if no stable DELTA_K exists but at least one ADMISSION_APPLICABLE_BRIDGE_GROUP is recovered in >= 1 individual treatment repetition relative to baseline

preserved_phase0_contracts.probe_history: the Phase-0 read-only fusion/payload-coverage probe remains deterministic frozen-trace feasibility inspection, never reinterpreted as an experiment (REAL_CASE_RERANKER_CALLS = 0, REAL_CASE_SELECTIVITY_RUNS = 0)
preserved_phase0_contracts.payload_contingency_superseded: the narrow Phase-0 registry-extension contingency is replaced by the generic complete_replay_surface_gate contract (mechanically materialize ALL missing required replay objects before Phase-2 exposure; no case-specific branch; the g020 concept-node observation remains a disclosed example only)
accepted_phase0_architecture_unchanged: candidate authority = additive retrieval candidate only

phase1_may: materialize the complete replay surface mechanically

superseded_rule_notice.notice: this artifact's SAFE_EFFECTIVE-based budget_selection_rule (SAFE_EFFECTIVE(K) = DELTA_K > 0 AND REGRESSION_K == 0) was further refined by Phase0-R1-R1: budget selection now uses MECHANISTIC_SAFE_EFFECTIVE(K) = CAUSAL_DELTA_K > 0 AND REGRESSION_K == 0 with the causal-safe hierarchy, and the verdict precedence was extended to 7 levels including PARTIAL / POOL_PERTURBATION_ASSOCIATED_RECOVERY_WITHOUT_RESERVED_WITNESS and the narrowed FAIL scope; SAFE_EFFECTIVE is retained here as a historical record and as a broader diagnostic

decision_basis: all three contract defects are completely repaired in the Phase-0 machine preregistration and human report: the two replay surfaces plus the complete object universe, selector-text contract, registry separation, materialization gate, and parity target are explicit; the benefit/safety populations, DELTA/REGRESSION metrics, SAFE_EFFECTIVE, the corrected decision hierarchy, the causal witness, and the total verdict precedence are conflict-free; the authoritative graph channel, the no-rerun/no-double-merge prohibitions, and the corrected BASELINE chain remove the graph-authority ambiguity; all accepted Phase-0 architecture is unchanged
